native50.autoexec_bat:
@ECHO OFF
PATH C:\PHAR_LAP;C:\DOS
CD \PHAR_LAP
ECHO SUITE_BEGIN>C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
ECHO BEGIN TICKRUN>>C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
TICKRUN > C:\RESULTS\TICKRUN.TXT
IF ERRORLEVEL 1 GOTO ERR0
ECHO RC TICKRUN 0>>C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
GOTO END0
:ERR0
ECHO RC TICKRUN NONZERO>>C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
:END0
ECHO END TICKRUN>>C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
ECHO ALL_DONE>>C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
TYPE C:\RESULTS\STATUS.TXT
ECHO PHAR_LAP_SUITE_FINISHED
